item.title: New moon, and two planets turn forward
item.description: The new moon in Scorpio, plus Mercury and Venus end their retrogrades.
item.content:encoded:
New moon, and two planets turn forward

The new moon in Scorpio, plus Mercury and Venus end their retrogrades.

Monday's new moon in Scorpio opens a fresh cycle. Then, later in the week, both Mercury and Venus turn direct after weeks of retrograde. If the last month felt like walking through fog, you may feel things start to move again.

The moon this week

Waning crescent on Sunday, with the Moon in Scorpio.

In the sky this week

  • Mon, Nov 9, 12:03 AM: New moon in Scorpio
  • Fri, Nov 13: Mercury turns direct in Scorpio
  • Fri, Nov 13: Venus turns direct in Libra

Retrograde this week: Mercury in Scorpio, Venus in Libra, Saturn in Aries, Uranus in Gemini, Neptune in Aries.

This week's Human Design gates

The Sun begins the week in Gate 1, Self-Expression (line 4), and the Earth sits opposite in Gate 2, Direction. On Wed, Nov 11, the Sun moves into Gate 43 (Insight) and the Earth into Gate 23 (Assimilation). Everyone feels the Sun's gate in the background this week, whether or not it's in their own chart. Treat it as a theme to notice, not a forecast.

Get outside

Before the week gets busy, step outside on Monday evening. The moon is invisible at the new moon, so it's a good night to notice the stars.

item.title: A quiet week to finish things
item.description: A waning moon, Mercury still retrograde, and a question about what's complete.
item.content:encoded:
A quiet week to finish things

A waning moon, Mercury still retrograde, and a question about what's complete.

We start November under a waning moon, the part of the cycle that's made for finishing rather than starting. Mercury and Venus are both still retrograde, so this is a good week to review, tidy up and close open loops before you take on anything new.

The moon this week

Last quarter on Sunday, with the Moon in Leo.

In the sky this week

  • A quiet week, with no major shifts in the sky.

Retrograde this week: Mercury in Scorpio, Venus in Libra, Saturn in Aries, Uranus in Gemini, Neptune in Aries.

This week's Human Design gates

The Sun begins the week in Gate 44, Alertness (line 2), and the Earth sits opposite in Gate 24, Rationalization. On Thu, Nov 5, the Sun moves into Gate 1 (Self-Expression) and the Earth into Gate 2 (Direction). Everyone feels the Sun's gate in the background this week, whether or not it's in their own chart. Treat it as a theme to notice, not a forecast.

Get outside

Early November light is low and golden. Try ten minutes outside in the late morning, when the sun is at its warmest.
